direct_foundations.serde: Versioned persisted/wire JSON encoding; do not hand-write parser/derive machinery.
direct_foundations.serde_json: Versioned persisted/wire JSON encoding in engine and legacy core, not Store.
direct_foundations.blake3: Cryptographic content IDs and integrity/key-ID commitments. Pure Rust implementation selected.
direct_foundations.chacha20poly1305: XChaCha20-Poly1305 authenticated encryption, OS randomness and key zeroization.
direct_foundations.ring: Ed25519 signed managed-state and audit witnesses; required by managed record API.
direct_foundations.zstd: Standard Zstandard codec, existing magicless frames and dictionary training.
direct_foundations.lz4_flex: Safe checked legacy LZ4 block compatibility; no frame wrapper.

algorithm_exceptions.fastcdc: Keep dependency-free FastCDC v2020 chunk boundaries; store owns dedup references and format. Replacement requires an independent maintainability/performance case.
algorithm_exceptions.aho-corasick: Keep established multi-pattern search used for managed-record occurrence verification.
algorithm_exceptions.rust-stemmers: Keep pinned English stemming semantics and rankings; replacement needs parity proof.
algorithm_exceptions.libc: Keep platform locking, no-follow opens and crash/drill process primitives; do not invent bindings.

rules: No general database, provider/cloud, network runtime, benchmark database or experimental codec in the minimal engine graph.
Crypto, cryptographic randomness and standard codec implementations are not to be rewritten to reduce counts.
Changes to this reviewed allowlist or Cargo.lock require scope/use/security/format review and meaningful affected gates.
Normal build graph is cargo build (engine/rank/store); CLI and tool packages require explicit package/feature selection.
Cargo.lock is a workspace resolution, not a production dependency inventory. Run scripts/dependency_audit.py --check.
Features are additive: explicitly selecting benchmark packages or --workspace intentionally includes their dependencies.
